en: The Set of Twos beginning with Grasping (Upādānaduka), and the Set of Threes beginning with Visible (Sanidassanattika).
Dependent on a non-clinging, invisible, and impinging state, there arises a non-clinging, visible, and impinging state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three;
under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under result condition there is one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there is one.
